pretreatments.description: Mechanical disintegration: The wastewater sludge was shredded using a blender prior to addition into the reactors.

Ultrasonic pre-treatment: Wastewater sludge samples were subjected to ultrasonication at 20 kHz, 70% amplitude, and 200 W power for 15 and 30 minutes, resulting in Specific Energies of 15,000 kJ/kg TS and 25,000 kJ/kg TS, respectively, to increase solubility and reduce particle size (d50 reduced by ~69-81%).

Microwave pre-treatment: Wastewater sludge samples were subjected to microwave thermal disintegration using a Microwave Digestion Unit (Berghoff Speedwave MWS-3+) at 175 °C and 2000 kPa for 30 minutes, optimizing the disintegration degree and specific energy input.

Co-digestion process: Wastewater sludge and olive pomace were mixed in weight ratios of 1/1 (w/w basis) and fed into the anaerobic digesters in batch-fed reactors to adjust C/N ratios and enhance nutrient balance.
Control treatment: Reactors R1 containing only inoculated sludge without substrate or pretreatment were used as a control baseline.
